notes.title: POSSIBLE PROGRESS LOSS - READ INSIDE FOR MORE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I realized that a recent change made to the game files - to implement New Game+ mode - may have resulted in people losing their progress through the levels of the game.

If this is the case for you, please be advised that you can fix it by taking the following steps:

1) Find the game files in your Steam installation (on a typical install, the location of these files will be C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Weaves of Fate)

2) Inside the game files, navigate to assets->player_profile and open profile.xml with your text editor of choice.

3) Inside the profile file, look for the 'current_level' attribute. It will likely be set to 0. If you remember the level number that you had unlocked, update the current_level to that number. If you do not, please try updating it incrementally , saving the file and then relaunching the game until your level select screen is back to normal. Make sure after you are done editing the profile.xml file, you save it.

I apologize unreservedly for the mistake if I did in fact blow away anybody's level progress; please note that this should not have affected your character upgrades, the only affected progress should be your level progression.

If after attempting these steps, anybody is still struggling with restoring their level progression or just needs additional help getting back to the state they were in before the New Game+ update, please do post here and I will support.

notes.title: NEW GAME+ MODE - 19/09/2017 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I just finished adding a New Game+ mode to the game and have pushed the update to Steam. With the New Game+ mode you can now play through the game after completion with tougher foes and stronger enemy configurations.

You keep all of your character upgrades after starting new game plus though, so make the most of your exp. points while you can!

I also snuck a fix into this update for a major bug where the game was crashing sometimes if you got a little too click-happy on the magic menus. 

Stay tuned for more usability tweaks coming soon, I aim to clear up some of the biggest complaints with the game jumping around a bit too fast, and also the lack of clear information about character health after taking damage.

Thanks all for your patience and I hope you continue enjoying the game!

notes.title: 08/08/2017 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all!

I've just pushed a new update for the game which should fix a couple of issues and address some of the concerns people are having. 

The list of changes are as follows:

- Game now launches into fullscreen mode by default.
- Alt + Enter will now toggle the game between fullscreen and not.
- Fixed critical bug which would result in the game crashing sometimes in non-English languages.

Planned changes for next update:

- Adding fullscreen toggle into options menu
- Mouse support/integration

notes.title: Weaves of Fate Now Released!
notes.content:
Weaves of Fate has now been officially released (well, you're on the Steam page for it so I assume you already know that!).

I just wanted to say a big thank you to everyone who supported the game and left their feedback on both the Steam Greenlight campaign and the Store page in the past few days. All of it was useful in one way or another, regardless of whether positive or negative.

It's been a long road getting here, but now we're finally there. This is just the start of the journey, and I just want to make sure everybody knows that I'm committed to building on this. If anybody encounters any issues or bugs, or simply has a new feature request, feel free to post it or reach out and let me know.

Thanks again everyone!
